service.description: Learner licence applied on Sarathi (Parivahan); the test is taken online or at the RTO and the learner licence is printed after it.
service.depending: Aadhaar Card (with the mobile number linked), proof of age, passport size photo and signature (if asked)
service.rules: The applicant must be 18 or older (16 for a gearless two-wheeler below 50 cc). Give the slip with the application number to the customer.
